title: TranscriptRecord
description: Handoff object emitted by agent-reach's YouTube reliability ladder (references/youtube.md, step 6) and consumed by youtube-knowledge-extractor's AI-analysis step. This is the single agreed shape between the two skills — agent-reach never emits raw VTT + metadata.json across the handoff boundary, and youtube-knowledge-extractor never assumes its own local {title, channel, transcript} shape when invoked from agent-reach.

video_id.description: YouTube video ID, e.g. from yt-dlp --dump-single-json .id

url.description: Canonical webpage_url, not the input URL as typed (drop playlist/timestamp params).

published_at.description: ISO8601 upload date, null when yt-dlp cannot resolve it.

transcript_text.description: Normalized plain text — VTT headers/timestamps stripped, consecutive auto-caption duplicate/overlapping cues removed, unique speech preserved. Never raw VTT.

transcript_source.description: Which rung of the reliability ladder (references/youtube.md) produced transcript_text.

coverage.description: complete: full video covered. partial: gaps exist (chunked, rate-limited, or ASR dropped segments) — callers must not treat this as a full transcript. blocked: no transcript could be produced; transcript_text is empty and downstream analysis must not run.

retrieved_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this record was produced, for cache/staleness decisions downstream.
